measures.title: Columbus County Malt Beverage Election
measures.summary: Asks Columbus County voters whether to permit the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages in the county.
measures.yesMeans: The "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages is permitted in Columbus County.
measures.noMeans: This election does not authorize the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages.

measures.title: Columbus County Unfortified Wine Election
measures.summary: Asks Columbus County voters whether to permit the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of unfortified wine in the county.
measures.yesMeans: The "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of unfortified wine is permitted in Columbus County.
measures.noMeans: This election does not authorize the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of unfortified wine.

measures.title: Columbus County Mixed Beverage Election
measures.summary: Asks Columbus County voters whether to permit the sale of mixed beverages in hotels, restaurants, private clubs, community theatres and convention centers, and the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages and unfortified wine in qualified establishments in the county.
measures.yesMeans: The sale of mixed beverages in hotels, restaurants, private clubs, community theatres and convention centers, and the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages and unfortified wine in qualified establishments is permitted in Columbus County.
measures.noMeans: This election does not authorize the sale of mixed beverages in hotels, restaurants, private clubs, community theatres and convention centers, and the "on-premises" and "off-premises" sale of malt beverages and unfortified wine in qualified establishments.

measures.id: Columbus County Local Sales and Use Tax Referendum
measures.title: Columbus County Local Sales and Use Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Columbus County should levy a local sales and use tax at the rate of one-quarter percent (0.25%) in addition to all other State and local sales and use taxes.
measures.yesMeans: The additional 0.25% local sales and use tax may be levied in Columbus County.
measures.noMeans: The additional local sales and use tax is not levied.
